result:
Big workspace. Not single crate — 236+ member crates under `crates/`.

**Size:** files=3754, symbols=54554, modules=436, calls=82911 edges (per carto). Workspace root `Cargo.toml` lists 236+ crates.

**Main pieces (by import fan-in/out, top hub modules):**

- **gpui** — own UI/app framework (windowing, entities, async, rendering). Everything built on top of it (`in=1017` fan-in — most-depended-on internal crate). Split further: `gpui_macos`, `gpui_linux`, `gpui_windows`, `gpui_web`, `gpui_wgpu` (platform backends), `gpui_macros`, `gpui_tokio`.
- **editor** (`editor.rs` out=71, biggest hub) — core text editing engine, heaviest single-file fan-out in repo.
- **workspace** — window/pane/dock management, ties editor+UI together.
- **project** — project model: files, LSP, buffers, worktrees (`project.rs` out=40).
- **agent / agent_ui / agent_servers / agent_settings / agent_skills** — Zed's AI agent stack (chat, tool use, ACP protocol via `acp_thread`, `acp_tools`).
- **edit_prediction / edit_prediction_context / edit_prediction_ui / edit_prediction_cli** — AI inline completion feature, separate cluster.
- **LLM provider crates** — `anthropic`, `bedrock`, `google_ai`, `deepseek`, `codestral`, `copilot`, `copilot_chat`, `cloud_llm_client`, `cloud_api_client` — model backends.
- **dap / dap_adapters / debugger_ui / debugger_tools** — Debug Adapter Protocol / debugging support.
- **git / git_ui / git_graph / git_hosting_providers** — git integration.
- **collab / collab_ui / channel / call** — real-time collaboration + comms layer.
- **extension / extension_api / extension_host / extension_cli / extensions_ui** — extension system.
- **fs, fuzzy, fuzzy_nucleo, collections, clock, db** — low-level utility crates (used repo-wide).
- **zed** (`crates/zed/src/zed.rs`, the top-level binary) — wires everything into the actual app.

**Top external deps** (by fan-in): `std`(1204), `gpui`(1017), `anyhow`(536), `collections`(410), `futures`(309), `serde_json`, `parking_lot`, `smallvec`, `itertools`.

Shape overall: custom UI framework (gpui) at base → editor/project/workspace core → feature crates (git, debugger, extensions, collab) layered on → AI/agent stack as a large parallel cluster → `zed` binary assembles all.
